name: autocad-mcp
description: AutoCAD automation + architectural drafting for Claude. Drives full AutoCAD via COM, AutoCAD LT via the file-IPC dispatcher, or generates DXFs headlessly via ezdxf. Ships the `architectural-drafting` skill and the `autocad-architect` subagent, plus a project model that indexes DWG/DXF projects into SQLite for audits (AIA layer compliance, broken XREFs, dim/text style drift, sheet sets).
